items.text: Canonical QA status is the default current QA authority for v1.4.11+ flows.
Legacy QA status can be read only through explicit compatibility admission and must be labeled as historical evidence.
Release checks and scorecards cannot pass from legacy-only QA status.
Markdown PRD remains requirement truth and legacy PRD mirror cannot override it.
Current PRD projection drift remains blocking when the current projection is stale or inconsistent.
Legacy PRD mirror mismatch is downgraded to compatibility warning by default.
QA and PRD legacy mirror policies are bound to compatibility registry entries.
Tests prove this slice does not delete legacy files or change implement, prototype, browser, memory, intent, or command behavior.

state_machine: `legacy_mirror_registered -> current_only_default_required`: accepted by the v1.4.11 Phase 4 and Phase 5 scope decision.
`current_only_default_required -> explicit_compat_admission_available`: implementation may preserve historical project support through explicit admission.
`explicit_compat_admission_available -> legacy_only_pass_authority_blocked`: QA and release checks prove legacy-only status cannot pass.
`legacy_only_pass_authority_blocked -> mirror_policy_release_ready`: all current authority and compatibility evidence paths are auditable.
`legacy_mirror_registered -> legacy_file_deletion`: blocked because this slice is policy-first, not deletion-first.
`legacy_mirror_registered -> implement_loader_migration`: blocked because implement package migration is a later feature.
`legacy_mirror_registered -> prototype_or_browser_policy_change`: blocked because prototype, browser, memory, and intent are later features.
`legacy_only_pass_authority_blocked -> release_ready`: blocked unless implementation, QA, and release evidence close normally.
decision_priority: Markdown PRD, user-story, and test-case remain requirement truth.
Canonical QA status and current `.machine` projection remain current authority surfaces.
Legacy mirrors may remain compatibility evidence only.
Legacy-only evidence must fail closed for current QA and release.
Explicit compatibility admission must leave machine-readable evidence.
No legacy file deletion or unrelated behavior retirement belongs in this slice.

inputs_contract: conditionally required `prototype` when the feature has real UX/UI handoff
current gate / blocked reason / branch or execution governance context when present
decision_protocol: Enter `implement` only after requirement truth is frozen enough for execution.
Block when frozen truth requires `change`, when cutover guardrails fail, or when a conditionally triggered prototype is still missing.
Keep `implement` as the only execution entry; `ask --execute` and support surfaces may route here but must not replace it.
Prefer explanation and routing logic in skill surface; keep final schema, contract, and gate writes in Python guardrails.
When dual-read or compatibility windows exist, fail closed on mismatch.
anti_inertia_notes: `implement` is not permission to rewrite requirement truth.
`goal`, task ledgers, or partial execution progress do not define completion truth.
If the feature needs UX/UI handoff and prototype is triggered, do not skip straight into coding.
Team/runtime internals stay internal unless the user explicitly asks for them.
`implement` cannot rewrite frozen truth or override gate truth by itself.
learning_notes: Reuse implementation learning to avoid repeated blocked paths or flaky cutovers.
Learning may shape route explanation and caution, but cannot override gate truth.
Downgrade stale learning instead of silently trusting it.
backstop_cli: `beacon qa ...` after implementation evidence is ready
decision_surface.primary_reason: Enter `implement` only after requirement truth is frozen enough for execution.
